messages:
Alex (growth): Quick thread — noticed the weekly KPI board popped after Friday's launch posts, small ask: can we reconcile the lead delta vs last week? Dashboard shows +18% sessions but only +3% MQLs. https://dash.redwood.com/s/marketing/kpi-weekly :thinking_face:
Maya: I saw that too. initial hypothesis: utm_source mismatch on the launch-post CTA (we sent both twitter and community links). Could be double-counting sessions from the same user.
Ibrahim: Paging the routing rules — inbound leads might be getting deduped differently depending on source param. I'll pull the raw event counts.
Tess: Also flag: the webinar registration ad had lower CTR but higher registration conversion. Might be quality > quantity. We should check channel-level CPL and registration-to-MQL rates. :bar_chart:
Alex (growth): Good point. My quick look showed webinar registrants convert to MQL at 18% vs organic 9%. But total webinar traffic was small.
Maya: I can run a cohort split tomorrow AM. Quick SQL I used to get week-over-week MQLs (feel free to reuse):
```
SELECT event_date, utm_source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as leads, SUM(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-15'
  AND event_type = 'lead_submitted'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2;
```
Ibrahim: Ran a lightweight check — raw sessions show +18% from referral domains, but unique lead form submits only +2%. Looks like post-click pages had a JS debounce change Friday that reduced duplicate submits but also might have reduced conversions for some UTM paths.
Tess: That tracks with the deploy notes — OpsBot pushed a small form update to reduce bots. OpsBot: Deploy note: form-debounce v1.2 rolled at 2026-03-13 23:40 UTC by frontend-team. No rollbacks.
Alex (growth): Okay, plan: Maya will run cohort analysis by utm_source + landing template, Ibrahim to map routing/dedup rules (esp. when utm_missing), Tess to pull ad-level registration -> mql curves. I'll summarize findings in Monday's KPI review. Can we aim for updates by EOD Monday?
Maya: Yep, I'll have the cohort table and top 3 noisy utm paths.
Ibrahim: Will map routing and check dedupe logs. If I find mismatch I'll add a note to the dashboard explanation panel.
Tess: I'll export ad-level funnel and share a short slide.
Alex (growth): Thanks everyone. If anything urgent before Monday ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Maya: one more thing — I recommend adding a tiny blurb to the KPI board explaining the form-debounce change so future weeks don't get misread as channel performance regression.
Ibrahim: Agree, will add an annotation on the dashboard for 2026-03-13.
OpsBot: Annotation created on kpi-weekly: "2026-03-13 form-debounce v1.2 — may affect raw leads across referral UTM paths"
Alex (growth): Perfect. Closing thread for now — will reopen if any blockers show up.
